description: This PHP source file defines the SavingsPlansClient class within the Aws\SavingsPlans namespace, which interacts with the AWS Savings Plans service. It declares methods related to creating, deleting, describing, listing tags, returning, tagging, and untagging savings plans, including both synchronous and asynchronous variants.

classes.name: SavingsPlansClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Savings Plans service, extending the base AwsClient class.
